finding.legacyRule: filter global membership -> lexicographic symbol sort -> global slice(0,cap)
defects: A global cap can starve one price pool even when both pools have eligible rows.
Lexicographic symbol order is deterministic but not a defensible randomized/outcome-free sampling frame; lower/earlier symbol IDs receive systematic priority.
CHANNEL_NEAR_MISS cannot satisfy the preregistered pool x nearestChannel x failed-check-pattern frame through the legacy API.
